places.name: White Tower of Thessaloniki
places.ai_summary: A historic monument and museum, the White Tower is a symbol of Thessaloniki and offers panoramic views of the city.
places.place_tip: Climb to the top for the best views of the city and the sea.

places.name: Archaeological Museum of Thessaloniki
places.ai_summary: A museum showcasing artifacts from Macedonia’s rich history, including ancient gold treasures and sculptures.
places.place_tip: Don’t miss the Derveni Krater, a masterpiece of ancient metalwork.

attribution.title: Metro Thessalonikis-New Railway Station (cropped)
attribution.author: User:Lambros Kazan

places.name: Mount Olympus
places.ai_summary: The legendary home of the Greek gods, Mount Olympus offers stunning hiking trails and breathtaking views.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours for safety.

places.place_tip: Bring proper hiking gear and check the weather before your visit.

attribution.title: Olympus National Park 30
attribution.author: kallerna
attribution.description: Peaks of Mount Olympus seen from the blue route, Olympus National Park, Greece.

places.name: Aristotelous Square
places.ai_summary: The central square of Thessaloniki, Aristotelous Square is known for its impressive architecture and vibrant atmosphere.
places.place_tip: Visit the square in the evening to enjoy the lively atmosphere and street performances.

attribution.title: Aristotelous Plateia 2006 (cropped)
attribution.author: User:JFKennedy
attribution.description: Aristotelous Square in Thessaloniki, Greece. Photo taken 2006.

places.name: Rotunda of Galerius
places.ai_summary: Originally built as a mausoleum for Emperor Galerius, the Rotunda is a massive round building with impressive mosaics.
places.place_tip: Look for the beautiful mosaics inside, depicting various hunting scenes.

attribution.title: Ac.galerius2
attribution.author: Adam Carr
attribution.description: The Tomb of Galerius, now the Church of Agios Giorgios or Church of the Rotonda, in Thessaloniki, Greece.

places.name: Arch of Galerius and Roman Palace
places.ai_summary: The Arch of Galerius is a triumphal arch that once marked the entry to the Roman Palace of Galerius.
places.place_tip: Great spot for photography, especially during sunset.

attribution.title: Ac.galerius2
attribution.author: Adam Carr
attribution.description: The Tomb of Galerius, now the Church of Agios Giorgios or Church of the Rotonda, in Thessaloniki, Greece.

places.name: Aigai (Vergina Royal Tombs) UNESCO Site
places.ai_summary: The ancient city of Aigai, the first capital of Macedonia, is home to royal tombs and impressive archaeological finds.
places.place_tip: Visit the museum first for an introduction to the site’s significance.

attribution.title: Entrance to the Royal Tombs, Vergina - panoramio
attribution.author: Colin W
attribution.description: Entrance to the Royal Tombs, Vergina

places.name: Mount Athos (Viewed by boat, access restricted)
places.ai_summary: A prominent mountain and the site of an important monastic community, Mount Athos is a UNESCO World Heritage site.

opening_hours.notes: Access to the mountain is restricted; viewable by boat only.

places.place_tip: Book a boat tour in advance and check the weather conditions.

attribution.title: Paisios of Mount Athos
attribution.author: Spartacos31
attribution.description: Mosaic of Agios Paisios the Agiorites on the right side of the entrance of the Monastery of Saint John the Theologian (Souroti).  There, where on July 12, 1994 he fell asleep and his grave is located, where thousands of people from all over the world worship.

places.name: Thessaloniki Roman Agora
places.ai_summary: The Roman Agora of Thessaloniki was the center of public life in the Roman city, with ruins of important buildings still visible.
places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for more Roman ruins and historical sites.

attribution.title: The Roman forum
attribution.author: Leandro Neumann Ciuffo from Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

places.name: Vlatades Monastery
places.ai_summary: A historic Byzantine monastery offering stunning views of Thessaloniki and the sea.
places.place_tip: Respect the dress code: shoulders and knees should be covered.

places.name: Museum of Byzantine Culture
places.ai_summary: This museum offers an extensive collection of Byzantine artifacts, including icons, frescoes, and manuscripts.
places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique Byzantine-inspired souvenirs.
places.address: Museum of Byzantine Culture, Thessaloniki, Greece

attribution.title: Macedonian Museums-88-Arx Byz Thessaloniknhs-391
attribution.author: Prof. Vlasis Vlasidis
attribution.description: Front view, image from the Museum of Byzantine Culture, Thessaloniki, Central Macedonia, Greece

places.name: Ano Poli (Old Town Thessaloniki)
places.ai_summary: The old town of Thessaloniki, Ano Poli is known for its traditional houses, narrow streets, and panoramic views.
places.place_tip: Wander the streets and enjoy the traditional tavernas and shops.

attribution.title: Ναός Αγίας Αικατερίνης, Θεσσαλονίκη 1953
attribution.author: C messier
attribution.description: The byzantine church of Saint Catherine, Thessaloniki

places.name: Dion Archaeological Park
places.ai_summary: An important archaeological site, Dion was a sacred city of the Macedonians with ruins of temples, theaters, and baths.
places.place_tip: Visit the Sanctuary of Zeus and the ancient theater.
places.address: Dion Archaeological Park, Central Macedonia, Greece

attribution.title: Dion archaeological site 102
attribution.author: stg_gr1
attribution.description: the Archaeological site at Dion

places.name: Litochoro Village (Gateway to Olympus)
places.ai_summary: A picturesque village at the foothills of Mount Olympus, Litochoro is the starting point for many hikers.
places.place_tip: Explore the village and try the local cuisine in one of the traditional tavernas.

attribution.title: Olympmassiv-litochoro
attribution.author: Mboesch
attribution.description: Litochoro: Blick vom Lookout von oben her

places.name: Agios Dimitrios Church
places.ai_summary: A historic church dedicated to Saint Demetrius, the patron saint of Thessaloniki, known for its impressive mosaics.
places.place_tip: Admire the beautiful mosaics and the impressive architecture.

places.name: Kastra (The Walls of Thessaloniki)
places.ai_summary: The ancient walls of Thessaloniki, offering a glimpse into the city’s Byzantine past and stunning views from the top.
places.place_tip: Walk along the walls for panoramic views of the city and the sea.

attribution.title: Ierissos village, Stagira-Akanthos municipality, Chalkidiki prefecture, Greece - Ancient Akanthos house - 01
attribution.author: Christaras A
attribution.description: Ancient house of Akanthos city, exacavated in Ierissos village, Stagira-Akanthos municipality, Chalkidiki prefecture, Greece.

places.name: Pella Archaeological Site (Alexander the Great's birthplace)
places.ai_summary: The ancient city of Pella, the birthplace of Alexander the Great, with impressive archaeological remains and a museum.
places.place_tip: Visit the on-site museum for a comprehensive understanding of the site's significance.
places.address: Pella Archaeological Site, Central Macedonia, Greece

attribution.title: Statue of Alexander the Great riding Bucephalus and carrying a winged statue of Nike (square of Alexander the Great) in Pella city (6914694770)
attribution.author: Carole Raddato from FRANKFURT, Germany
attribution.description: Statue of Alexander the Great riding Bucephalus and carrying a winged statue of Nike (square of Alexander the Great) in Pella city

places.name: Nea Fokea Tower
places.ai_summary: A well-preserved Byzantine tower in the village of Nea Fokea, offering beautiful views of the sea.
places.place_tip: The tower is located near the beach, so combine your visit with some time by the sea.
places.address: Nea Fokea Tower, Central Macedonia, Greece

places.name: Kapani Market
places.ai_summary: A vibrant market in the heart of Thessaloniki, Kapani Market is the perfect place to experience local life and cuisine.
places.place_tip: Try the local delicacies at the market stalls and enjoy the bustling atmosphere.
